topicRecords.summary:
Teach shared algebra once, preserving separate local facets. UPCAT/USTET officially name Mathematics; their finer depth is unpublished in the accepted records. DOST names Algebra in the historical 2026 primer, with 2027 continuity unknown. Most CET/SM finer methods are curriculum or weak preparation candidates, with SHS track/cohort/completion limits. CSE 2026 PPT officially names English word problems; additional algebra is largely weak reviewer preparation. No single roster establishes equal whole-lesson scope, current item language, runtime availability or full exam coverage. Practice and later standards remain deferred.

- Split candidates: exponent manipulation versus logarithm teaching; one-variable linear solving versus coordinate line/half-plane reasoning. These separate reusable foundations from different method goals and conditional scope. Costs: approved new identities/routing, moved examples/traps, missing-method additions and later practice review. Evidence: exponents-and-logarithms lines 12-44, 60-157; linear-equations-inequalities lines 12-35, 75-118 (L01/L17/L19 structural use).
- Retain polynomial operations, quadratic solving, simultaneous-equation methods and the six-scenario modeling lesson as coherent shared goals. Thin division/root-search labels need actual teaching before a further split can improve learning. Reorder the function-family overview so necessary meanings precede applications; do not create one unit per family.
- Important local gaps: polynomial division and Rational Root Theorem; general polynomial-factor rational operations, rational equations/inequalities; quadratic/exponential/logarithmic inequalities; explicit variation models and higher-degree polynomial graph interpretation. Monomial power quotients, radical rationalization, motion/work patterns and quadratic vertices are present, so these gaps are deliberately narrower. Other-topic reconciliation remains with the lead.
- Completing the square, formula solving, range derivation, constrained composition/inverse branches and some graph methods have missing or thin worked applications. No arbitrary example minimum is used. Detailed facet evidence occurs once in the appendix.
- Two narrow prerequisite edges are proposed: function-family teaching needs the definition/inverse pairing in Functions and Relations; current line-plotting instructions need coordinate address/axis meanings. Existing repeated procedures, supplied factored expressions, converted percentages and supplied roots do not justify extra edges. Both ends are cited below.
- All owned prompts supply the deciding formulas, pairs, region facts or counts in text. No load-bearing figure dependency was found, including the shaded-region and Venn examples. Markers do not prove runtime display or illustration sufficiency.
- Encountered concerns: single-input verification is insufficient; the power-of-power rule needs precise domain restrictions; generic system graphing must allow nonlinear curves. topicRecords.summary:
- Retain shared introductory chemistry once; no supported exam-specific deletion or excess verdict follows from current unknown depth.
- Split candidate: separate composition-to-formula inference from reaction quantities in stoichiometry. This improves goal focus and a basic-to-extended preparation route, at the cost of a new approved lesson identity, moved examples/traps, and later linked-practice review.
- Reorder candidate: teach Lewis construction before deriving VSEPR groups. Definitions alone cannot supply this foundation (L01/L17/L19). No full Lewis, formal-charge or resonance procedure appears in the 17 chemistry bodies.
- Local gaps: dilution, dynamic chemical equilibrium, Kinetic Molecular Theory, molecular dipole cancellation/intermolecular reasoning, and experimental variable/data interpretation. Their source tiers and exam-depth uncertainties remain explicit.
- Thin applications: branched organic naming, concrete functional-group/property comparisons, simple reaction product mole/mass chains, theoretical yield derived from reactants, and concentration-to-pH use. Periodic-table named families are not explained despite the outline facet (B03/L01 structural use).
- Biomolecule/safety coverage is absent locally. Whole inventory identifies biology and other safety/background search leads; the lead must reconcile other topic findings before any corpus-wide gap claim.
- No load-bearing figure dependencies encountered: all chemistry example prompts supply enough textual givens to be attempted. This is neither an illustration-sufficiency verdict nor runtime verification.
- Prerequisites use existing IDs and both-end evidence only. Missing Lewis/equilibrium foundations have no invented lesson targets. Intralesson ordering is separate. Basic mathematical literacy is assumed; no unsupported arithmetic roadmap edge is asserted.
- Required depth, Science language, cohort exposure, current cycle continuity, student availability and practice remain unresolved. Source checks here are bounded encountered facts, not a Level 4 correctness sweep.

topicRecords.summary:
Shared teaching can serve several exams once: Earth spheres, motions/eclipses, rock-cycle processes, plate mechanisms and basic weather distinctions. UPCAT/USTET officially name broad Science only; DOST Earth/Space domains are official for 2026 with 2027 continuity unknown. DCAT/PUPCET finer scope is weak or inferred; ACET/SM Science inclusion is unconfirmed. CSE Professional climate background serves English General Information, not a Science subject. Curriculum and SHS track/cohort/completion limits remain. Bodies are English; other Science item languages, tested depth and student access remain unknown. Practice is deferred Level 5.

- Split candidate: separate regional weather/atmospheric processes from climate mechanism and impacts. The latter needs impact/action teaching, not merely a moved paragraph. Benefit: focused shared climate preparation and environmental decisions. Cost: approved new identity/routing, new applications, moved examples/traps and later practice review. Evidence: weather-and-climate lines 12-35 versus 37-43 and 47-81; cse-professional-L055, ustet-L126.
- Retain the other coherent cores. Combined origin models explicitly contrast cosmic and Solar System scales. Water-reservoir context directly serves hydrology; a thin currents paragraph is not sufficient grounds to split existing teaching. Evidence: origin-of-the-universe lines 12-29, 63-65; water-cycle-oceanography lines 12-30, 56-65.
- Local gaps: seasonal constellations, planet/star comparison and stellar development, tides, breezes/ITCZ, monsoon/cyclone formation mechanisms, Philippine resources/geothermal uses and hazard/impact decisions. Mechanism/classification names do not establish applied coverage. Detailed facet evidence is recorded once below (L01; required depth qualifiers retained).
- Inquiry is partly demonstrated through qualitative geologic, seismic and cosmic evidence. Explicit variable/control identification and direct measured graph/table/map interpretation remain absent or thin locally; this is not a corpus-wide gap claim. References: dcat-L077 and ustet-L113.
- Examples generally stand on textual givens; no load-bearing figure dependence was encountered. The origin diagram prompt describes the misconception in words (lines 35-42). Marker presence supplies no runtime or illustration-sufficiency proof.
- No strictly necessary existing-lesson prerequisite link was found in the completed local readings. Each lesson has an explicit status. Redshift is a local foundation gap with corpus placement unresolved; introductory term/context additions should precede evidence use without invented roadmap targets.
- Encountered accuracy concern: indirect-only mantle wording needs distinction from direct sampling of mantle-origin rocks. Source ledger preserves the bounded author-abstract evidence and remaining drilling-history uncertainty. No content was changed.

Accepted source packets: [UPCAT](../requirements/upcat.md), [DCAT](../requirements/dcat.md), [ACET](../requirements/acet.md), [USTET](../requirements/ustet.md), [PUPCET](../requirements/pupcet.md), [DOST-SEI](../requirements/dost-sei.md), [SM Foundation](../requirements/sm-foundation.md), [CSE Professional](../requirements/cse-professional.md). Exact requirement IDs carry each packet source URL/page and confidence. Science preparation source: [DepEd JHS guide](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Science-CG_with-tagged-sci-equipment_revised.pdf), pp. 7-8, 16, 103-104, 121-122, 168, 176-177. Conditional sources: [Earth and Life Science](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/detail/14509), [Physical Science](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/detail/14519), competencies, and [Strengthened General Science](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/GENERAL-SCIENCE-1.pdf), pp. 7-8. Historical domain: [DOST 2026 primer](https://science-scholarships.ph/pdf/2026_DOST-SEI_UG_Primer.pdf), p. 12. These accepted-source links are traceability, not new exhaustive organizer/source verification.
